title: potentilla cuneifolia
intro: Potentilla cuneifolia, commonly known as Five-Pointed Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla cuneifolia include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
